title: Ijwi Rirwanya Ibiremereye Bitari byo
intro: Umuntu w’indahemuka yakuriye mu bacuruzi n’abacuruzi mu gihugu aho iminzani yari irahengamye kandi ibipimo bigabanuka. Uyu muntu yari wenyine arwanya ubuhemu bw’igihugu cyose, abahamagarira kunyura mu butabera no gusenga Imana Imwe y’Ukuri. Nubwo ubutumwa bwari busobanutse neza kandi umuhamagaro wari ugororotse, abantu banze kumva maze bahura n’amakuba akomeye. Ese ushobora kumenya iyi ntumwa y’icyubahiro yo muri Korowani?
clues: Natumwe nk'intumwa ku bantu batunze imibereho yabo ishingiye ku bucuruzi n'ubucuruzi.
Abantu banjye bari bazwi mu gihugu cyose kubera gutanga ibipimo bigufi no gushuka ibipimo.
Nanone bateraga abagenzi ubwoba mu nzira kandi bakwirakwiza ruswa ku isi yose.
Nabasabye gusenga Allah wenyine no kuba inyangamugayo mu mibanire yabo n'abandi.
Banze ubutumwa bwanjye kandi bantera ubwoba ko bazanyirukana mu gihugu hamwe n’abizera hamwe nanjye.
Allah yankijije jye n'abayoboke banjye ku bw'imbabazi ze, mu gihe abakora ibibi bafashwe n'ibihano bikomeye.

arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا شُعَيْبًۭا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍۢ مِّنَّا وَأَخَذَتِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دِيَـٰرِهِمْ جَـٰثِمِينَ
verse: And when Our command came, We saved Shuʿayb and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us. And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone (11:94)
